skins.name: Harmonic Plains
skins.blurb: Open grassland: wheat-straw plaster, golden afternoon air, a sage-and-gold woven drum.

skins.name: Rhythmic Ridge
skins.blurb: Volcanic mountains: dark basalt, ember uplights, an obsidian drum with a molten rim.

skins.name: Melodic Forests
skins.blurb: Dense forest: moss-green plaster, dappled leaf light, a tree-ring drum.

skins.name: Silent Sands
skins.blurb: Desert stillness: layered sandstone, soft diffuse light, a pale dune-ripple drum.

skins.name: Vibrato Valleys
skins.blurb: Caves and underground rivers: wet slate, teal water light, a drum of concentric ripples.
